```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)

set.seed(1)
```

```{r data, include=FALSE}
data("ny_noaa")

noaa_df =
  ny_noaa |>
  mutate(
    year = lubridate::year(date),
    month = lubridate::month(date, label = TRUE, locale = "C"),
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,
    prcp = prcp / 10
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(tmax), !is.na(tmin), tmax >= tmin)

noaa_sample =
  noaa_df |>
  sample_n(5000)
```

Column {data-width=550}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Daily maximum vs. minimum temperature (random sample of 5,000 station-days)


```{r scatter}
noaa_sample |>
  mutate(
    text_label = str_c("Station: ", id, "\nDate: ", date,
                       "\nTmax: ", tmax, " °C\nTmin: ", tmin, " °C")
  ) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~tmin, y = ~tmax, color = ~month, text = ~text_label,
    type = "scatter", mode = "markers", alpha = 0.5, colors = "viridis"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Minimum temperature (°C)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Maximum temperature (°C)"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Month"))
  )
```

Column {data-width=450}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Distribution of daily maximum temperature by month (random sample)


```{r boxplot}
noaa_sample |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~month, y = ~tmax, color = ~month,
    type = "box", colors = "viridis"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Maximum temperature (°C)"),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )
```

### Annual average temperature across all NY stations

```{r lineplot}
noaa_df |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(
    mean_tmax = mean(tmax),
    mean_tmin = mean(tmin)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    mean_tmax:mean_tmin,
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "temperature"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    measure = recode(measure, mean_tmax = "Average Tmax", mean_tmin = "Average Tmin")
  ) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~year, y = ~temperature, color = ~measure,
    type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Average temperature (°C)"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Measure"))
  )
```
